all_words.explanation: A chapter is a main division of a novel, so the word is directly connected to the form of the book.
A bulldozer is a construction machine and has no connection to literature or the structure of a book.
The plot is the sequence of events that drives a novel, so it belongs to the same topic of fiction writing.
Parsley is a herb used in cooking and has no relation to novels or literary analysis.
The narrator is the voice that tells the story in a novel, so the word is closely linked to the genre.
A pulley is a simple machine for lifting loads and is unrelated to literature.

explanation: A novel is a long work of fiction; the associated words describe its parts (chapter), its structure (plot), and its voice (narrator), while the others belong to unrelated fields.
